description: This file contains utility functions and context managers for controlling and switching between different JIT fusion and optimization strategies in PyTorch, including enabling/disabling specific fusers, setting fusion strategies, and managing optimized graphs.

methods.name: optimized_execution
methods.description: Context manager to enable or disable JIT graph optimizations.

methods.name: fuser
methods.description: Context manager to switch between different backend fusers in PyTorch.

methods.name: _get_differentiable_graph_node
methods.description: Recursively collects differentiable graph nodes from a given node.

methods.name: _graph_for
methods.description: Retrieves the graph for a given method or function.

methods.name: _script_method_graph_for
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the graph for a scripted method, including differentiable nodes.

methods.name: set_fusion_strategy
methods.description: Sets the fusion strategy with a list of (type, depth) pairs for fusion backends.
